fixed_plan.selection: Chosen before evaluating localization: corridors, four room rows, different furniture and shapes, doorways, and varied headings. Ground truth is for audit only.

identity.measurement_note: 4 threads per registration; fixed four physical P cores on logical CPUs 0,2,4,6. Original 10 Hz paced replay. Wall includes backlog processing, excludes map load and frontend/DDS. Same full input for both variants. Updated per Xian before evaluation started.

audit_band.purpose: Separate gross wrong locks from intended-location locks; not a new product threshold or a precision acceptance criterion.

limitations: One full paired four-core run per position, plus separate meeting repeats and final normalized replay; not repeated-run medians.
First lock starts at first LIO input after map loading. Map load is separate, and ROS transport, frontend and simulator CPU are excluded.
All 296 exact LIO pairs per bag, original 10 Hz pace, no frame drops. Difficult runs accumulate backlog; CPU/input-second is required work per sensor second, not instantaneous occupied cores.
Truth uses one fixed mapping-session first-pose alignment; no per-query fit. Frontend-only drift audits use their own first-pose alignment and are not localization scores.

Old full probes lack actual coasted output poses. Meeting full-run accuracy remains unscored there; the separately replayed output-aware old versions retain their own timings and truth scores. Their repeated lock counts vary, so do not splice repeat accuracy into the original full run.
Wrong lock at position 11 and no locks at 09/14 remain failures. First-correct-lock latency summaries exclude all three.
Simulation with ideal sensors, fixed poses and pre-existing map error; no moving/out-of-map/dynamic or RK3588 qualification.
Quaternion normalization fixes internal nonrigid-pose feedback; retrieval and decision gates are unchanged. No overall precision improvement or difficult-search half-core claim.

baseline.truth_score_error: Probe has coasted outputs; backend pose alone cannot score them

current.truth_score_error: Probe has coasted outputs; backend pose alone cannot score them

candidate_admission_audit.scope: Diagnostic only, excluded from timings. Ground truth used only to label nearby map keyframes after the run.
candidate_admission_audit.finding: Nearby keyframe 759 first appears in the third query. The existing confirmation path only updates established hypotheses and does not seed this new region before locking to 818/819 in the fifth query. Counterfactual success from adding that region has not been established.

offline_oracle_diagnostic.scope: Offline truth-seeded registration only; excluded from localization accuracy, success rate and timings. Does not prove descriptor-seeded recovery or final lock acceptance.
